Vs.

full_judgment: 15. The learned Advocate for the state submits that even on the evidence of a single witness the conviction can be maintained in view of section 134 of the Evidence Act and in support of his contention he has cited a decision reported in 29 DLR (SC) 211 and another reported in 4 BCR (AD) 114. The principles as laid down in those decisions are not disputed. It is true that it is the quality and not the quantity that has to be seen in the evidence. Even on the basis of the evidence of a single witness conviction of an accused can be maintained provided that single prosecution witness is wholly and fully reliable. But in the instant case I have already found that P.W.I the informant and the only alleged eye-witness of the occurrence is not of that quality and he is not wholly or fully reliable. Hence, it is unsafe to base conviction of the accused on his evidence applying the principles laid down in the above cases. Apart from that the prosecution case suffers from serious defect is not producing the alamats of the case. In the instant case there is no evidence save and except the evidence of P.W. 1 to prove the alamats, that is the seized articles and from this angle also, the prosecution case suffers from suspicion. Lastly as I have stated above, that out of 8 charge-sheeted witnesses three material witnesses namely Sepoy Benowar Hossain, Sepoy Ayub Ali and Serajul Islam alleged to have accompanied P.W.1 and laid in ambush have not been produced and another Sultan who alleged to have alied the P.Ws. 2 and 3 at the camp has also not been produced by the prosecution in this case for reasons unknown and naturally non-production of these witnesses gives rise to adverse presumption against the prosecution case. Thus for the reason stated above I cannot but hold that the prosecution has totally failed to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt and the learned Special Tribunal has illegally convicted and sentenced the appellant and hence the impugned order of conviction and sentence is liable to be set aside.
